_comment: Store listing screenshots for Partner Center, in listing order. Each caption is the image's `description` (Store limit: 200 characters). The Store file name is prefixed with a content hash by update_listing.py, so re-uploading changed pixels under the same name cannot silently no-op.

captions.en-us: Your work at a glance: sprint progress, today's focus and project health on one dashboard.
captions.de-de: Alles auf einen Blick: Sprint-Fortschritt, Tagesfokus und Projektstatus auf einem Dashboard.

captions.en-us: Scrum and Kanban boards with drag & drop, WIP limits and live sprint progress.
captions.de-de: Scrum- und Kanban-Boards mit Drag & Drop, WIP-Limits und laufendem Sprint-Fortschritt.

captions.en-us: Every issue in its place: grouping, sorting, filters, priorities and assignees.
captions.de-de: Jeder Vorgang an seinem Platz: Gruppierung, Sortierung, Filter, Priorität und Zuständigkeit.

captions.en-us: Timeline and Gantt view with dependencies, milestones and live progress.
captions.de-de: Timeline- und Gantt-Ansicht mit Abhängigkeiten, Meilensteinen und Live-Fortschritt.

captions.en-us: Reports that matter: burndown, velocity, cycle time and issue distribution.
captions.de-de: Aussagekräftige Reports: Burndown, Velocity, Cycle Time und Verteilung der Vorgänge.

notesForCertification: Screenshot and description update after the 2026-08-17 report. Every listing image is the Windows desktop build of Hinata in a standard Windows 11 window (title bar with minimize, maximize and close); no other platform's UI, devices, artwork or symbols appear in the images or in the description.
